Why belief has to come before every plan.

Kevin Trudeau points to Elon Musk's idea that the first step is to establish that something is possible. Then probability follows.

Kevin explains that this means getting your mindset right first. He also shares Warren Buffett's view that the best investment is in yourself: learn how to use your mind.

Which goal have you not yet decided is possible?

#ad #mindset #goals #kevintrudeau

You don't become what you want. You become what you believe.

Kevin Trudeau shares what Steve Jobs said about trusting that the dots will connect in the future, and Oprah Winfrey's line about belief.

Kevin calls it a knowingness. He says doubt acts like self-sabotage, and that clearing it out matters if you want belief to work.

Wanting is easy. Believing is the harder part.

Where do you want something but doubt you can have it?
